reserves.name: GHO staked in Aave Umbrella safety module

sources.label: stkGHO verified proxy and ERC-4626 asset observation at Ethereum block 26095800

reserveReview.rationale: At Ethereum block 26095800, asset() returned GHO 0x40d16fc0246ad3160ccc09b8d0d3a2cd28ae6c2f and convertToAssets(1e18) returned 1e18. The single-asset ERC-4626 wrapper holds GHO, with automated slashing able to reduce the redeemable value. The 100% slice describes the wrapper's underlying identity, not a measured diversification or absence of slashing risk.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Standing single-asset ERC-4626 wrapper structure, confirmed by pinned asset() at Ethereum block 26095800
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The wrapper's GHO identity is verified; GHO's own backing and controls remain parent exposure. Future deficits can reduce redeemable assets through automated slashing.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: GHO is held in an upgradeable on-chain staking vault and is exposed to Umbrella slashing. The reviewed documents do not establish legal segregation, insolvency treatment, or reuse restrictions.
